source_documents.title: Modifying the AIE-TADF chromophore with host-substituents to achieve high efficiency and low roll-off non-doped OLEDs

reference_evidence_units.quote: host-substituents didn’t participate in intramolecular charge transfer.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including pPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DFT frontier orbitals of the emitter series.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The peripheral host substituents are not assigned to the CT channel.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This exclusion concerns peripheral groups, not the DPS-PXZ chromophore's CT state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: They all showed obvious solvatochromic, which indicated strong CT state in these four molecules.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including pPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvent-dependent emission spectra, with target spectra reported in SI.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source links solvatochromism to CT in the emitter cores.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The target's SI curve is not independently available in this packet.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the molecular rotations were restricted more easily when the water content was increased.
reference_evidence_units.subject: pPhDCzDPSPXZ and mPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water aggregation series and comparison of N-linked emitters.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source attributes stronger AIE behavior to easier restriction of motion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Water fraction also changes solvation and aggregation; this is the authors' mechanistic interpretation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The PL intensities of pPhDCzDPSPXZ and mPhDCzDPSPXZ were increased by 6.4–6.7 times when the water was added to 90% compared to that of pure THF solution
reference_evidence_units.subject: pPhDCzDPSPXZ and mPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.statement: Both N-linked compounds show enhanced emission in the aggregation experiment.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The range is for the pair; do not assign one endpoint to the target without checking the figure.

reference_evidence_units.quote: All of them included prompt fluorescence parts with the lifetimes between 46.2 and 55.2 ns and slow decay components were in the range of 0.62–0.76 μs
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including pPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neat-film transient PL decay under nitrogen.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The emitter series displays prompt and delayed decay components.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Two decay components alone are not a unique TADF diagnostic.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The reverse intersystem crossing rate constants (kRISC) of pPhDCzDPSPXZ and mPhDCzDPSPXZ were 2–3 folds than DCB-DPS-PXZ and mCP-DPS-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.subject: pPhDCzDPSPXZ and mPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Rate constants derived from measured photophysics using the source's SI formulas.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source derives faster rISC for the N-linked pair.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are derived rates, not directly observed transitions; SI derivation is not independently rechecked.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The delayed component exhibited a clear temperature dependence effect, which demonstrated thermally activated mechanism feature.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including pPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Temperature-dependent neat-film emission, 100 to 300 K; target data cited in SI.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The temperature dependence supports thermally activated delayed emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The main figure shows the meta analogue; target-specific SI spectra still need retrieval.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The introduction of host-substituents didn’t participate in ICT but functioned on dispersing excitons
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including pPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Source interpretation of the covalent self-host design.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source assigns an exciton-dispersing function to peripheral substituents.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Self-host means covalently attached substituents, not a measured guest-binding complex or independent external matrix.

reference_evidence_units.subject: pPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 2, neat-film photophysics; absolute PL quantum yield under nitrogen.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target-specific table row reports prompt/delayed lifetimes of 52.0/750.0 ns, prompt/delayed quantum-yield contributions of 29/26%, total PLQY of 55%, and a 548 nm peak. Derived kRISC and Kf are 6.3 x 10^5 and 5.1 x 10^6 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This row avoids assigning series ranges to the target. The two rates and separated yields are derived quantities, not direct transition measurements; SI formulas and target-specific temperature/oxygen traces still need checking.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the intensity of the delayed portion was obviously increased after oxy­ gen removal.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Four emitters including pPhDCzDPSPXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neat-film fluorescence decays in nitrogen and air, Figure 4b and SI Figure S7.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The text reports increased delayed emission after oxygen removal for the studied series.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure 4b displays the meta analogue. The para target's SI trace is not yet independently available. Retain this as a main-text report, not a verified target-specific SI measurement.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The paper presents motion restriction as its explanation of the target series' AIE response.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The core has CT character; the peripheral host design should not be misread as an additional primary CT channel.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The derived rISC and prompt/delayed contributions explain emissive-state utilization within the same TADF account.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Thermally activated delayed fluorescence and rISC are central to the studied emitter behavior and are within the existing organic-triplet family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The paper presents motion restriction as its explanation of the target series' AIE response.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Covalent self-host wording is not sufficient to establish a separate external packing/matrix mechanism. The source's aggregation-dependent motion account is already retained under RIM.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Covalently attached host substituents are not evidence of a supramolecular host-guest binding event.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT

structure_verification.problem: carbazole carries the 4-(carbazol-9-yl)phenyl at C2; the paper has it at C3
structure_verification.basis: SI synthesis: pPhDCzDPSPXZ = N-arylation of 3-(4-(9H-carbazol-9-yl)phenyl)-9H-carbazole, which is made from (9H-carbazol-3-yl)boronic acid; OPSIN parse of the 3-substituted name = proposed; MS/EA C54H35N3O3S (same formula as case, so mass cannot separate the isomers)
evidence: SI synthesis: pPhDCzDPSPXZ = N-arylation of 3-(4-(9H-carbazol-9-yl)phenyl)-9H-carbazole, which is made from (9H-carbazol-3-yl)boronic acid; OPSIN parse of the 3-substituted name = proposed; MS/EA C54H35N3O3S (same formula as case, so mass cannot separate the isomers)
